lead.claim: Structured exercise may improve survival outcomes for patients with cancer.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: This systematic review of 21 RCTs explored structured exercise's impact on overall and disease-free survival, mortality, and other outcomes in cancer patients.

supporting.claim: Exercise dose for chronic low back pain needs more study.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This systematic review with network meta-analysis looked at exercise dose and its short-term effects on disability and pain in chronic low back pain.

supporting.claim: Combined ankle and short-foot exercises may boost balance in flatfoot athletes.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: A randomized controlled trial compared combined 3D ankle and short-foot exercises to short-foot exercises alone in female karatekas with flatfoot.

supporting.claim: Opioid use is normalized after spinal cord injury.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This qualitative study explored healthcare provider and patient views on opioid use after spinal cord injury, finding overreliance due to limited non-pharmacological supports.
